package handler_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"example.com/remote-test/game/handler"
	sender "example.com/remote-test/game/handler/sender"
	syncsender "example.com/remote-test/game/handler/syncsender"
	"example.com/remote-test/game/requests"
	"example.com/remote-test/game/view"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/fctx"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type localEntity struct{ *entity.EntityBase }

func (e *localEntity) Base() *entity.EntityBase { return e.EntityBase }

type getter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g getter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	return g[id], nil
}
func (g getter) GetMany(_ context.Context, ids []int64, _ []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	es := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		es[i] = g[id]
	}
	return es, nil
}

var unavailable = errors.New("view unavailable")

type resolver struct {
	entered, release chan struct{}
	once             sync.Once
}

func (r *resolver) ResolveRemoteSnapshot(a nest.RemoteAccess) (entity.RemoteSnapshot, error) {
	if !fctx.InIOWorker() {
		return entity.RemoteSnapshot{}, errors.New("resolver outside IO worker")
	}
	if a.Ref.Version == 99 {
		return entity.RemoteSnapshot{}, unavailable
	}
	if a.Ref.Version == 1 {
		r.once.Do(func() { close(r.entered) })
		<-r.release
	}
	return entity.RemoteSnapshot{EntityID: a.Ref.EntityID, Kind: a.Ref.Kind, Scope: a.Scope, RouteEpoch: a.Ref.RouteEpoch, Version: a.Ref.Version, Data: view.Alliance{Bonus: 42}}, nil
}
func TestGeneratedRemoteView(t *testing.T) {
	// 独立消费工程只在此用例注册 kind；多次运行复用注册和 handler。
	register.Do(func() {
		entity.RegisterEntityBuilder(&entity.EntityBuilderParam{Category: entity.EntityCategoryOther, Kind: 240, NoPersist: true, Builder: func(*entity.EntityCreateParam) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) { return nil, nil }})
		entity.RegisterEntityBuilder(&entity.EntityBuilderParam{Category: entity.EntityCategoryRemote, Kind: 241, RemotePolicy: entity.RemotePolicyManaged, Lifetime: entity.EntityLifetimeRemoteManaged, NoPersist: true, Builder: func(*entity.EntityCreateParam) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) { return nil, nil }})
		handler.RegisterHandlerNestHandlers()
		handler.RegisterSecondNestHandlers()
	})
	id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(100, 240)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	id2, err := entity.BuildEntityID(101, 240)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	g := getter{id: &localEntity{entity.NewEntityBase(id, entity.EntityCategoryOther, true)}, id2: &localEntity{entity.NewEntityBase(id2, entity.EntityCategoryOther, true)}}
	r := &resolver{entered: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	var unblock sync.Once
	defer unblock.Do(func() { close(r.release) })
	engine := nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(g), nest.NestOptionWithRemoteSnapshotResolver(r), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 32}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 1, QueueCap: 32}))
	if err := engine.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer engine.Shutdown(context.Background())
	// 失败退出也先解除 resolver，防止 StopNest 等待它。
	defer unblock.Do(func() { close(r.release) })
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	syncClient := syncsender.NewNestSender(engine)
	asyncClient := sender.NewNestSender(engine)
	remoteID, err := entity.BuildEntityID(102, 241)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ref := entity.RemoteViewRef{EntityID: remoteID, Kind: 241, Version: 1}
	done := make(chan int64, 1)
	if err := asyncClient.Send_Query(ctx, id, requests.Query{AllianceViewRef: ref, Done: done}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	select {
	case <-r.entered:
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	// 唯一 I/O worker 正在等；唯一业务 worker 仍可处理另一 ID。
	if got, err := syncClient.Sync_Ping(ctx, id2); err != nil || got != id2 {
		t.Fatalf("local ping: %d %v", got, err)
	}
	unblock.Do(func() { close(r.release) })
	select {
	case got := <-done:
		if got != 42 {
			t.Fatal(got)
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
	}
	ref.Version = 2
	if got, err := syncClient.Sync_Query(ctx, id, requests.Query{AllianceViewRef: ref}); err != nil || got != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("query: %d %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := syncsender.NewSecondSender(engine).Sync_Second(ctx, id, &requests.Query{AllianceViewRef: ref}); err != nil || got != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("shared request: %d %v", got, err)
	}
	ref.Version = 99
	if _, err := syncClient.Sync_Query(ctx, id, requests.Query{AllianceViewRef: ref, Done: done}); !errors.Is(err, unavailable) {
		t.Fatalf("required: %v", err)
	}
	select {
	case <-done:
		t.Fatal("required failure ran handler")
	default:
	}
	if ok, err := syncClient.Sync_Optional(ctx, id, &requests.Optional{AllianceViewRef: ref}); err != nil || ok {
		t.Fatalf("optional: %v %v", ok, err)
	}
}

var register sync.Once
